name: open-knowledge-skills

metadata.description: Agent Skills for working inside OpenKnowledge projects.

//grouping: One plugin per pack (plus the platform + meta skills) so a whole pack installs with `/plugin install <pack>@open-knowledge-skills`. A decomposed pack lists its orientation skill plus every scenario skill it ships — the plugin IS the pack boundary. skills.sh itself lists every skill flat; this grouping is the Claude Code /plugin channel.

plugins.name: open-knowledge
plugins.description: Platform skill: teaches an agent to work in an OpenKnowledge project (MCP reads/writes, grounding, linking, live preview).

plugins.name: write-skill
plugins.description: Author a well-triggered SKILL.md for OpenKnowledge or your editors.

plugins.name: discovery
plugins.description: What OpenKnowledge is and how to set it up on a repository (ok init / ok cowork / OK Desktop) — discovery and install guidance, no MCP required.

plugins.name: codebase-wiki
plugins.description: Work in a Codebase Wiki project: an agent-authored, source-grounded wiki of the surrounding codebase.

plugins.name: knowledge-base
plugins.description: Work in a source-grounded Knowledge Base: external-sources -> research -> articles.

plugins.name: entity-vault
plugins.description: Work in a Personal CRM / typed-entity vault (people, companies, meetings, concepts; GBrain-compatible).

plugins.name: software-lifecycle
plugins.description: Work in a Software Lifecycle project: proposals -> decisions -> specs -> postmortems, plus guides.

plugins.name: writing-pipeline
plugins.description: Work in a Writing Pipeline project: ideas -> drafts -> published.

plugins.name: worldbuilding
plugins.description: Work in a Worldbuilding project: a fiction encyclopedia of characters, settings, factions, and lore.

plugins.name: okf
plugins.description: Work in an OKF project: a knowledge base conformant with Google's Open Knowledge Format from commit one.

plugins.name: plain-notes
plugins.description: Work in a Plain Notes project: a flat notes/ folder plus a daily journal.
